Class CausalBufferPolicy

java.lang.Object
io.parsley.CausalBufferPolicy
public final class CausalBufferPolicy extends Object
Defines what happens to a record on each type of causal violation. Configure a uniform action for all violations via the static factories, or use builder() for per-violation-type control:
  • forwardUnsafe(CausalBufferLimit) — forward the record downstream out-of-causal-order (lenient)
  • drop(CausalBufferLimit) — silently discard the record (strict)
  • deadLetter(CausalBufferLimit) — route the record to the dead-letter sink (strict)

For mixed policies — for example, tolerating records from legacy non-Parsley producers while enforcing strict ordering for Parsley-stamped ones — use the builder: 

CausalBufferPolicy.builder()
    .onMissing(ViolationAction.FORWARD_UNSAFE)   // legacy producers: forward regardless
    .onUnresolvable(ViolationAction.DROP)         // malformed header: discard
    .onLimit(ViolationAction.DEAD_LETTER)         // buffer overflow: route to DLQ
    .setLimit(CausalBufferLimit.ofSize(1000))
    .build()

A CausalViolationHandler is always called regardless of which action is taken.
